press_references.value: Enfuce Enters Latin America With Swile, Launching Next-Gen Benefits Cards for Over 1 Million Brazilians

product_launches.description: Swile, in partnership with Enfuce, launched a multi-pan combo benefits card in Brazil that merges meal vouchers and multibenefit allowances, supports Google Pay, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay and Mastercard M4M, and will reach over 1 million existing users by mid-2026.

overview_description.description:
Swile got its start by disrupting the incumbent meal voucher market in France. Their all-in-one smartcard groups together all employee benefits such as meal vouchers, gift vouchers, and mobility benefits. Swile also aims to reinvent life at work and create a better work culture for all employees with their super app. Features include praises, event creation, collections and P2P payments between colleagues. They also offer employee engagement surveys and insight analytics. 

It was founded in 2018 by Loïc Soubeyrand and is based in Paris, France.

about_short_description.short_description: Swile is a digital solutions provider for employee benefits with an all-in-one smartcard and an app for team life.

product.name: Swile Card
product.description: A smart employee-benefits card that combines meal vouchers, gift benefits, mobility allowances, and culture vouchers in one physical or virtual payment card.

product.name: Swile App
product.description: A mobile and web application for using and managing Swile benefits, including card controls, real-time balances, payment notifications, and additional employee services.

product.name: Meal Vouchers (Titres-resto)
product.description: A digital meal-voucher solution that enables employers to provide food allowances through Swile cards for use at eligible restaurants, bakeries, supermarkets, and online food platforms.

identifier.value: Gift Benefits and CSE Platform (Titres cadeaux)

product.name: Gift Benefits and CSE Platform (Titres cadeaux)
product.description: A digital platform for distributing employee gift vouchers, holiday benefits, subsidies, and partner offers through physical or virtual cards and online gift marketplaces.

product.name: Swile Travel
product.description: A business-travel management service that lets companies arrange professional trips, manage travel expenses, and support more responsible transport and accommodation choices.

product.name: Mobility Benefits
product.description: A digital employee-benefit option for administering mobility allowances, including support for sustainable mobility and the Forfait Mobilité Durable.
